title: ubgo/validator errors
description: The body a failed validation returns: a list of issues, each locating one failure and naming it by a code a translator can key on.

code.description: Machine-readable identifier for the failure. Rule kinds have default codes (min_length, email); a rule's Meta.Code overrides; the structural values below are emitted without a rule. Not constrained to a closed set — a caller's own code is equally valid.

path.description: JSONPath of the failing value, in wire names: "$.tags[0].name". "$" is the whole value.

message.description: Rendered English message. A localizing consumer should ignore it and render from code plus params instead.

rule.description: The rule kind that failed. Absent for structural failures, which no rule produced.

params.description: Template variables for the message: the rule's operands, plus context such as the sibling field a cross-field rule names.
